# Pull Request Checklist

## Summary

- [ ] The change is limited in scope.
- [ ] Business logic is preserved.
- [ ] Routing is preserved.
- [ ] Storage schema is preserved.
- [ ] UI behavior is preserved.

## Documentation

- [ ] README updated if needed.
- [ ] Supporting docs updated if needed.
- [ ] Links and references are valid.

## Validation

- [ ] Markdown formatting checked.
- [ ] Broken references reviewed.
- [ ] No unrelated application code changed.

## Notes

- Include context, screenshots, or reproduction steps if relevant.
